definitions.explanation: An official document submitted to a municipal office to register a person's death. Required by law in Japan within seven days of the death.

examples.japanese: {死亡届|しぼうとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{死亡届|しぼうとどけ}は{七日|なのか}{以内|いない}に{届|とど}け{出|で}なければならない。
examples.english: A death notification must be submitted within seven days.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}の{死亡診断書|しぼうしんだんしょ}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{死亡届|しぼうとどけ}を{役所|やくしょ}に{持|も}って{行|い}った。
examples.english: I took the death notification along with the doctor's death certificate to the municipal office.

notes:
A compound of {死亡|しぼう} (death) and {届|とどけ} (notification/report). In the Japanese civil registration system ({戸籍|こせき}), a {死亡届|しぼうとどけ} must be filed with the local municipal office ({市区町村|しくちょうそん}{役場|やくば}) to officially register a death.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死亡届|しぼうとどけ}を{出|だ}す: to file a death notification
- {死亡届|しぼうとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a death notification (formal)
- {死亡届|しぼうとどけ}を{受理|じゅり}する: to accept a death notification

RELATED TERMS:
- {出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ}: birth registration
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}: marriage registration
- {死亡診断書|しぼうしんだんしょ}: medical death certificate (issued by a doctor)
- {戸籍|こせき}: family register
